title: SDK Adoption Pathway: language bindings, auth patterns, streaming ergonomics prioritization
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: We are triaging a set of incoming enterprise customer requests for SDK/client libraries across language support, auth patterns, and streaming ergonomics. Goal is to produce a prioritized roadmap and concrete tickets for ENG to implement enterprise-grade bindings and auth flows that meet SSO/KMS requirements and provide robust streaming UX (cancel, resume, backpressure). Background: Over the last quarter we received 18 discrete requests from enterprise accounts and partners asking for: first-class Java and Python SDKs with secure token lifecycle, explicit enterprise auth patterns (client credentials, mTLS, short-lived signed tokens compatible with corporate proxies), and improved streaming ergonomics for server-sent events / websocket fallbacks. Many asks reference regulatory needs (audit logs, per-request headers) and internal security requirements (KMS integration, key rotation). This ticket captures triage outcomes, prioritization rationale (RICE-style), and next-step deliverables for design and engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritization matrix completed with clear RICE scores and a recommended ordering for 6 language bindings
Auth design doc that covers client credentials, OIDC SSO flow pattern, token rotation guidance, and mTLS option for private deployments
Streaming ergonomics spec describing cancellation, reconnect, partial response buffering, and SDK-level helpers for backpressure
Pull requests / ENG tickets created for top-3 language bindings with initial API surface and example integration tests for enterprise scenarios
Security inputs collected and explicit 'security_review_required' flag set with checklist items for ENG implementation

2025-03-02 - Liam O'Connor: RICE scores attached and recommended ordering: (1) Java, (2) Python, (3) Node.js streaming improvements, (4) Go SDK, (5) Rust/C# exploratory. Filing ENG tickets for top-3 this week.
2025-03-03 - Maya Chen: Scheduled stakeholder sync for 2025-03-06 to align roadmap and allocate eng resources. Noted customer impact high and release target sdk-2025.04 for incremental deliverables.
decision: Apply RICE to raw asks. Recommendation: focus initial engineering effort on Java and Python SDKs with integrated enterprise auth flows (OIDC SSO + client credentials + optional mTLS) and a shared streaming ergonomics helper library. Node.js streaming UX to be improved in parallel for hosted customers. Go and Rust to be scoped as follow-ups. Rationale: Java/Python highest enterprise penetration and largest revenue signal; auth complexity and security review make them blockers for Dedicated/Private customers so early investment unlocks sales motion.
